user.title: Set up OCPP Central System
user.description: Listen address and port for the OCPP 1.6 WebSocket endpoint (ws:// only, see REQ-0016). Optional: a path to a static idTag authorization list, and a fixed idTag for remote start (REQ-0020) -- both changeable later via "Configure".

data.authorization_file: Path to the idTag authorization list (optional)

data_description.host: Network address the OCPP 1.6 WebSocket server listens on for charge points.
data_description.port: Port the OCPP 1.6 WebSocket server listens on for charge points.
data_description.authorization_file: Path to a JSON file containing a static list of allowed idTags.
data_description.default_id_tag: idTag the start/stop switch uses for RemoteStartTransaction.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure OCPP Central System
reconfigure.description: Change the listen address and port for this OCPP instance. The authorization list and default idTag are changed via "Configure" instead.

data_description.host: Network address the OCPP 1.6 WebSocket server listens on for charge points.
data_description.port: Port the OCPP 1.6 WebSocket server listens on for charge points.

set_power_limit.name: Set power limit
set_power_limit.description: Sets a connector's charging power limit (interop contract capability 3).

clear_power_limit.name: Clear power limit
clear_power_limit.description: Removes a previously set charging power limit (interop contract capability 4).

authorize_id_token.name: Authorize idToken
authorize_id_token.description: Queries OCPP's authorization source for an idToken (interop contract capability 8).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Optional. Disambiguates which OCPP instance to query when more than one instance happens to know the same charge point ID.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Resets the charging station (soft or hard reset).

reset_type.name: Type
reset_type.description: Soft (restart the software) or Hard (restart the hardware).

unlock_connector.name: Unlock connector
unlock_connector.description: Asks the charging station to unlock the connector.

get_configuration.name: Get configuration
get_configuration.description: Reads configuration values from the charging station.

keys.name: Keys
keys.description: Optional list of configuration keys to query -- leave empty for all.

change_configuration.name: Change configuration
change_configuration.description: Sets a single configuration value on the charging station.

value.name: Value
value.description: New value for the configuration key.

device_entry_not_loaded.message: Device "{device_id}" belongs to no loaded OCPP config entry.

device_not_connector.message: Device "{device_id}" is not an OCPP connector (it may be the charge point itself) -- this action requires a connector device.

device_is_connector.message: Device "{device_id}" is a connector -- this action requires the charge point device itself.

device_not_ocpp.message: Device "{device_id}" does not belong to OCPP.

authorization_file_unreadable.message: The authorization file "{path}" could not be read. Check that it still exists and contains valid JSON.

bind_failed.message: Could not bind the WebSocket server to {host}:{port}. Check that nothing else is using this port.

reset_rejected.message: Charging station rejected the reset command.

unlock_rejected.message: Charging station did not unlock the connector (status: {status}).

change_configuration_rejected.message: Charging station rejected the configuration change (status: {status}).

power_limit_rejected.message: Charging station rejected the power limit change (status: {status}).

no_default_id_tag.message: No idTag configured for remote start (REQ-0020) -- please set one when configuring the OCPP integration.

start_rejected.message: Charging station rejected the start command (connector {connector_id}).

stop_rejected.message: Charging station rejected the stop command (connector {connector_id}).

availability_change_rejected.message: Charging station rejected the availability change (connector {connector_id}).
